acceptance_gate: Check each frozen protocol on all 512 inputs of both primary wirings in all 24 question orders. Record unchecked proposals before certification and compare verified costs at the predeclared use counts and transfer prices.
completion_gate: Bind the fitted checkpoint, raw and certified plans, all delayed answers, exact compiler results and cost measurements. Independently replay the bound records.
objective: Fit NAND programs on other wirings, freeze the sender and receiver, and test whether they return exact three- and four-bit messages on nonlinear rewires. Compare all-in costs with an exact public cached compiler and direct four-answer transmission.
status: The frozen policy chose three bits on all 24 closed nonlinear layouts and four on all 24 one-source rewires, covering every input before checking. Certification repaired six proposals on the broader panel and returned 182,272/182,272 correct answers. The cached compiler used 312 bits to the learner’s 320 for one packet per wiring and cost less at all 20 modeled operating points.
stop_rule: Score the fitted policy on the bound panel and record every failed proposal and fallback. Any change to the policy or panel belongs to a separate study.
